module: Generic delay line: each data packet pushed into the line comes out after the same delay. Originally created to simulate the time unburnt fuel takes to travel through the exhaust before burning. The line must be polled regularly (pop/popSum) with the time step to retrieve what has reached the end.
usage:
local dl = require('delayLine').new(0.2)  -- delay 0.2 s
dl:push(5)
-- every frame:
local sum = dl:popSum(dt)
notes: The internal time (currentTime) only advances in pop and popSum, not in peek.
pop returns nil if the line is empty, otherwise an array (possibly empty). popSum returns 0 if empty; it assumes numeric data.
Packets come out in the order they went in (same delay for all).

delay.desc: Delay in seconds applied to each packet.

returns.desc: Object with the methods push, peek, pop, popSum, reset.

delayLine.desc: Object returned by new(delay). Fields: delay, length, currentTime, data, times.

push.desc: Inserts a data packet; it will come out at currentTime + delay.

pop.desc: Advances time by dt, removes and returns all packets that are due.

returns.desc: List of arrived packets; nil if the line is empty.

popSum.desc: Like pop but returns the (numeric) sum of the arrived packets.

returns.desc: Sum of the arrived packets (0 if none).

peek.desc: Returns, without removing them or advancing time, the packets that would have arrived within dt seconds.

returns.desc: List of packets; nil if the line is empty.

reset.desc: Empties the line and resets the internal time to 0.
